newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-SIAULIU H1 97 NET PROFIT DOWN TO 1.01 MLN.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-SIAULIU H1 97 NET PROFIT DOWN TO 1.01 MLN.

text.p: LIthuania's only regional bank Siauliu said on Wednesday that its net profit for the first half of 1997 fell to 1.01 million litas from 1.975 million litas in the same period last year.
The bank said in a statement that its assets as of June 30 rose to 95.1 million litas from 71.8 million litas at the beginning of the year.
It also said that its loan porfolio advanced to 53.7 million litas at the end of June from 42.3 million litas at the beginning of 1996.
The statement added that the deposits of the bank edged up to 51 million litas at the end of last month from from 42.3 million litas at the beginning of 1997.
The bank also said that its deposits at the end of May stood at 55.3 million litas.
Siauliu Bank is the only small regional bank to have emerged relatively unscathed from the banking crisis which broke in December 1995.
The bank posted a net profit for 1996 of 3.933 million litas.
